# Get Address From Input

iOS 14 +

## Notes

Gets addresses from the given input.

## Syntax

~~~~text
getAddressFrom(input: <#Variable (Optional)#>)
~~~~

## Example

~~~~text
getAddressFrom(input: Contact support@jellycuts.com)
~~~~
